items.title: Reproduce the loss end to end without any manual commit
items.context: Drive a story fixture through dev_memory_capture and then to DONE with no manual git add of .lattice/dev-memory/experience.jsonl, and show the captured entry is absent from main afterwards. B-def6 existing smoke deliberately commits the ledger first (to assert materialHash stability across a real commit), so it cannot see this path. The reproduction must exist before any fix.
items.userSees: A test that fails today, printing that the captured entry id is missing from the ledger on main after DONE completed successfully.

items.title: Decide whether materialHash exclusion and dirty non-blocking should remain a single registry grant
items.context: RuntimeArtifactRegistryEntry currently ties materialHash exclude and non-blocking dirty classification together; findRuntimeArtifactEntry drives both isMaterialExcludedRuntimeArtifactPath and the dirty-worktree category at dirty-worktree.ts line 204. The dev-memory ledger wants the first but arguably not the second. Decide whether to separate them or to guarantee durability another way, and record the rejected option.
items.userSees: A recorded decision naming the chosen mechanism and why the other options were rejected.

items.title: Implement the chosen durability guarantee
items.context: Whichever option is chosen, a captured lesson must survive DONE. If the fix writes during DONE, be careful that it does not move HEAD in a way that invalidates already-signed delivery-check or test-evidence freshness — that exact regression is documented in the dev-memory-finish-decision entry comment in runtime-artifact-registry.ts, which records that auto-committing was tried and reverted for this reason.
items.userSees: After DONE, the captured entry is present in the ledger on main with no manual git step.
